Here are all the direct callers of `TransportService.deregisterSession()` (excluding test files), plus the implementation class that must update its signature:

RELEVANT_FILES_START
common/transport/transport-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/common/transport/service/DefaultTransportService.java | implements TransportService.deregisterSession() — must update the overriding method signature
common/transport/transport-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/common/transport/service/TransportActivityManager.java | calls bare deregisterSession(sessionInfo) (delegating to TransportService) at line 104
common/transport/mqtt/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/mqtt/MqttTransportHandler.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession() at lines 1331 and 1452
common/transport/mqtt/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/mqtt/session/AbstractGatewaySessionHandler.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession() at line 809 inside its private deregisterSession helper
common/transport/http/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/http/DeviceApiController.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession(sessionInfo) at line 556
common/transport/coap/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/coap/client/DefaultCoapClientContext.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession(state.getSession()) at line 853
common/transport/lwm2m/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/lwm2m/server/session/DefaultLwM2MSessionManager.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession(sessionInfo) at line 69
common/transport/snmp/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/snmp/SnmpTransportContext.java | calls transportService.deregisterSession(sessionContext.getSessionInfo()) at line 208

**Note:** `AbstractGatewayDeviceSessionContext.java` was excluded — it calls `parent.deregisterSession(deviceName)` which is `AbstractGatewaySessionHandler`'s own helper method (taking a `String`), not `TransportService.deregisterSession(SessionInfoProto)` directly.
